title: HAL_I2C_Master_Transmit returns HAL_ERROR, nothing else known
user_question: I2C write fails every time. Why?

expected.root_cause: Insufficient evidence: status 1 (HAL_ERROR) covers NACK, bus error and arbitration loss; the device, its address value, wiring/pull-ups and HAL_I2C_GetError() are unknown.
expected.fix: Print HAL_I2C_GetError(&hi2c1), share the device part number and dev_addr value, and check SDA/SCL pull-ups with a scope or logic analyzer.
